about: The 'no internet - switch to SIM 2?' line from a kiosk alert's detail. The same file is in pos-server server/tests/fixtures and pos-android app/src/test/resources: both apps compose these exact lines (Kotlin SimPromptText, Python device_identity.sim_prompt_text).
